physical_form.shape: Tall cylindrical bottle with a subtle contoured waist for grip. Slightly narrower in the middle third, wider at the base for stability. Rounded shoulders tapering to the neck.
physical_form.cap: Orange plastic screw cap with a pull-up sport nozzle. Cap color matches the liquid color.
physical_form.neck: Short cylindrical neck with threading for screw cap
physical_form.body: Translucent plastic — the bright orange liquid is clearly visible through the bottle above and below the label area
physical_form.base: Flat circular base, slightly wider than the body, with molded ridges for stability
physical_form.label: White wraparound label covering approximately the middle 40% of the bottle. Features the Gatorade wordmark in bold black italic text, the orange lightning bolt icon, 'THIRST QUENCHER' in smaller text, and 'ORANGE' flavor designation. The label has a clean, bold, sporty design.

liquid.description: Bright, vivid orange — the signature Gatorade orange. Clearly visible through the translucent bottle.

cap.description: Orange plastic cap matching the liquid color

bottle_plastic.description: Clear/translucent plastic with a very slight frosted quality. Orange liquid shows through.

label_text.description: Bold black Gatorade wordmark on label

lightning_bolt.description: Orange lightning bolt icon on the label

rendering_instructions.camera_angle: Straight-on front view with very slight 3/4 rotation (5-10 degrees) so the label is fully readable but the bottle has depth and dimension
rendering_instructions.camera_height: Eye level — camera centered on the middle of the bottle
rendering_instructions.lighting: Clean, bright commercial product photography lighting. Key light from upper right, fill light from left. Slight rim light on the edges to define the bottle silhouette. The orange liquid should glow and look refreshing.
rendering_instructions.depth_of_field: Sharp focus on the entire bottle, slightly softer background
rendering_instructions.surface: The bottle should appear to be standing on a surface or floating cleanly — grounded, not awkward
rendering_instructions.condensation: Light condensation droplets on the outside of the bottle to convey cold refreshment. Not dripping wet — just lightly beaded.
rendering_instructions.reflection: Subtle reflection/shadow beneath the bottle for grounding

prompt_templates.base: A single Gatorade Thirst Quencher 28oz bottle, Orange flavor. Bright orange liquid visible through translucent plastic. Orange screw cap. White label with bold black Gatorade logo and orange lightning bolt. Light condensation on the bottle surface. Premium commercial product photography.

style_suffixes.athletic: Dynamic sports environment, motion energy, sweat and effort
style_suffixes.refreshing: Cool tones, ice, water splashes, extreme refreshment
style_suffixes.minimal_studio: Clean seamless background, dramatic product lighting, studio quality
style_suffixes.outdoor: Bright sunlight, natural setting, active lifestyle energy
